### What's new

- **Fixed:** opening a project (or any item from a board, table, timeline or calendar) showed a side panel that could not scroll and hid its close button. The panel now scrolls normally and its close button (**»**) is back in the top-left corner.
- You can also close the panel by clicking anywhere outside it, or by pressing **Esc**.

**Updating:** quit Fernando Notion (⌘Q on a Mac), download the file for your computer below and install it over the old app. On a Mac, drag it into Applications, choose **Replace**, and if macOS blocks it again, repeat the one-time **Open Anyway** step below. Your pages are not touched.

### Which file do I download?

| Your computer | Download |
| --- | --- |
| **Mac with an Apple chip** (M1, M2, M3, M4…) | `Fernando-Notion-…-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| **Mac with an Intel chip** | `Fernando-Notion-…-mac-x64.dmg` |
| **Windows** | `Fernando-Notion-Setup-….exe` (or the `Portable` .exe — no install needed) |
| **Linux** | `Fernando-Notion-…-linux-x86_64.AppImage` |

Not sure which Mac you have? Click the Apple menu  → **About This Mac**. “Chip: Apple M…” means Apple chip; “Processor: Intel…” means Intel.

### First launch on a Mac (one time only)

1. Open the `.dmg` and drag **Fernando Notion** into **Applications**.
2. Open it from Applications. macOS says it can't verify the app (it isn't from the App Store) — click **Done**.
3. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway** next to *“Fernando Notion” was blocked*, then confirm.
   On macOS 14 or older you can instead right-click the app → **Open** → **Open**.
4. If it asks to access your **Documents** folder, click **Allow** — that's where your pages are saved.

### First launch on Windows

Run the Setup `.exe`. If you see *“Windows protected your PC”*, click **More info → Run anyway**.

### Your pages

Everything is saved automatically in **Documents/Fernando Notion** (one file per page) with a daily backup. Updating the app never touches your pages.
